title: This is what's *wrong* with your LinkedIn profile ✍️
description:
No one is viewing your profile because you don’t have your work experience listed. Recruiters are looking for candidates by job title, in your headline yes, but most importantly in your work experience. The experience can be the same from your resume especially if you’ve put in the work to write some really great achievements but if you still need to do that check out the Teal Resume Builder for some help. #linkedintips #linkedin #linkedinprofile #linkedinprofiletips
